vehicle: Toyota Pickup (Hilux) SR5 Xtracab 4x4, 1985 (fourth generation, N60 series)
target: 1985 North American SR5 Xtracab 4x4, left-hand drive, 22R-E, solid front axle; fitted as the film truck
side_convention: left/right are the vehicle's own, seen from the driver's seat. North American LHD: driver sits on the left.
note: Every file is the largest standard-size copy Commons would serve (1,920 or 3,840 px wide). Wikimedia answered every request for an original from this container with HTTP 429 ("use thumbnail images in sizes listed on https://w.wiki/GHai"). Replace each with the original at original.url when it can be downloaded.
